purpose: Freeze current paper claims after non-computational science closeout and 2025-26 nearest-work subtraction. This is not a result ledger.

claims.claim: Scientific discovery can involve structurally useful remote donors that topical, lexical, citation or semantic proximity does not fully capture.
A protected donor-transfer study can separate candidate discovery, donor-native reconstruction, bounded relation mapping, challenge/counter-probes, target projection and novelty contraction.

The integrated process improves remote donor recovery or protected target/novelty-contraction decisions beyond the strongest information-matched parent federation while satisfying critical false-analogy and native-fidelity gates.
The integrated transfer process merits an independent scientific method claim.
Any gain in remote recall that violates the frozen critical false-analogy threshold does not constitute a scientific transfer advantage.
CANA/Analogical Reasoning in Science/ResearchBench/ReTRE and mature analogy/LBD/formal parents are direct controls, not weak baselines.
Scientific equivalence/comparability/transport is relation-, context- and decision-dependent across mature parent theories.
A common typed receipt can expose native relation family, context, direction, witnesses, loss/error, counter-probes, epoch and reopening consequence without replacing parent semantics.
The shared interface changes protected cross-parent reuse or reopening decisions beyond the strongest parent composition while preserving native judgments.
Context refinement: equality on every judgment in a richer declared context implies equality on every judgment in its subset.
Exact registered-decision-preserving mappings compose when both mappings preserve the corresponding registered decision.
Under exact sufficient-support-family semantics, a claim reopens iff every complete sufficient support family contains an invalidated member.
Under the same semantics, enlarging the invalidated set cannot restore a claim unless the support-family state itself changes.
Formal relation composition cannot by itself establish empirical transport or authority validity outside its registered decision/context.

prohibited: category theory applies to all relations
formal commuting diagram establishes empirical invariance

claims.claim: Scientific problem solving can be evaluated as control over plural scientific state, unresolved obligations and admissible interventions rather than by end-answer success alone.
The candidate V2 controller preserves all frozen V1 critical capabilities under the protected 59-cell non-compensatory parity protocol.
The candidate improves justified scientific terminals or intervention choice beyond strongest adaptive parent/donor-composed controls without unacceptable false completion or over-escalation.
Minimum sufficient escalation can be evaluated relative to a prospectively registered episode-specific partial preorder over interventions and a protected set of sufficient actions.
A universal total J0-J8 escalation ladder is not required; incomparable minimal sufficient interventions are valid and should be reported as a Pareto set.
Cross-domain stability or usefulness of minimum sufficient escalation is an empirical protected-result question.
Concept/representation change and formalism genesis require a witnessed lower-level insufficiency and protected predecessor recovery; new vocabulary alone is not a scientific residual.

Current AI-scientist systems already use planning, reflection, tree search, persistent memory, tool building, adaptive experiments and real instrument control; these are direct parents rather than novelty claims.
P-E opportunity discovery is one prospective action/problem-selection family in the current P-C paper unless real prospective future-value evidence supports a separate paper.

prohibited: all current agents are fixed pipelines
more explicit state is automatically better

claims.claim: Counts of supporting agents/sources/validators can overstate evidence under statistical or structural dependence.
Evaluator validity can change under distributional, strategic or performative response.

The candidate dependence/evaluator interface improves protected scientific calibration, validity or reopening decisions beyond strongest separate parent pipelines without blanket rejection of independent/stable controls.
Dependence and dynamic evaluation merit one common scientific assurance object.
Unknown dependence must not be silently treated as known independence; sensitivity/CANNOT_CHECK is a valid terminal.
Statistical/scientific support does not create external action or publication authority.
Recent multi-agent reliability limits, consensus-misalignment results and finite-evaluator reward-hacking theory are direct parents, not novelty claims.

prohibited: dependence and performativity necessarily form one theory
